SELECT u.*, d.org_code FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_dept_person dp ON u.user_relation_id = dp.person_id INNER JOIN sys_department d ON dp.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.org_code = #{orgCode} AND u.DISABLE_STATE = 'N' AND dp.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY u.CREATE_DATE DESC;

SELECT u.*, r.role_code, ptl.FULL_NAME, dp.company_id, dp.dept_id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role_b r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN sys_dept_person dp ON u.user_relation_id = dp.person_id INNER JOIN sys_org_person_tl ptl ON u.user_relation_id = ptl.person_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND dp.company_id = #{companyId} AND u.DISABLE_STATE = 'N' AND ptl.LANGUAGE = 'zh-CN' GROUP BY u.user_name ORDER BY u.CREATE_DATE DESC;

SELECT u.*, r.role_code, ptl.FULL_NAME, dp.company_id, dp.dept_id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role_b r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN sys_dept_person dp ON u.user_relation_id = dp.person_id INNER JOIN sys_org_person_tl ptl ON u.user_relation_id = ptl.person_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND dp.company_id = #{companyId} AND dp.dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.DISABLE_STATE = 'N' AND ptl.LANGUAGE = 'zh-CN' GROUP BY u.user_name ORDER BY u.CREATE_DATE DESC;

SELECT u.*, dp.company_id, dp.dept_id, ptl.FULL_NAME FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_org_person_tl ptl ON u.USER_RELATION_ID = ptl.PERSON_ID INNER JOIN sys_dept_person dp ON dp.person_id = u.USER_RELATION_ID WHERE u.DISABLE_STATE = 'N' AND ptl.`LANGUAGE` = 'zh-CN' AND ptl.FULL_NAME = #{fullName} AND dp.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY u.CREATE_DATE DESC;
